  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  May 23, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on May 23, 2024 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Angel Leon - Martel , Planning Department
  Cpt.Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department -2:06 p.m.
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Crystal McGlover, Emergency Service & Public Safety Department

  Staff Present:  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on May 09, 2024

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Gigi Chan on behalf of Los Angeles Fire Department to host a Fire Service Day Event at
  141 West Regent Street, Pubic Property, on Saturday, May 25, 2024, from 8:00 a.m. – 3:00
  p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Applicant to adhere to recommendations outlined by the Planning Department / Inglewood
  Police Department; Public Works Department; Approval for 1 day event on Regent Street
  and Fir Avenue. Subject to Public Works approval for use/closure of the right-of-way; IPD
  will staff one (1) sergeant, two ( 2) police officers deployed for public safety and four (4)
  TCO's for street closures / traffic control. Meridan barriers to be deployed on Regent St.,
  westbound from Grevillea Ave to Fir Ave. IPD watch commander will be notified and extra
  patrol-high visibility will be provided as time permits." Maintain site at all times, ensuring
  site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face
  mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State
  health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00384591)

Item #2:  Rachel Shannon on behalf of Wilder’s Prep Academy Charter to host an Annual Field Day
  Event at 700 Warren Lane,Edward Vincent Jr. Park ,Public Property, on Monday, June 3
  ,2024, from 7:00 a.m. – 1:30 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day event at Edward Vincent Park;
  Approved Conditionally; Applicant to hire a minimum of ten (10) professional / licensed
  security guards -OR- school security staff members to control the ingress and egress of
  the parking lots being used for this event. Security, faculty-staff, volunteers are to wear
  reflective vests so that they are readily identifiable as safety team members; male and
  female security - staff deployed to the public restrooms being used by guests for safety of
  those (specifically children) utilizing the restrooms and prevent any potential lewd conduct
  by outsiders. Applicant to also hire Parks & Recreation Staff to maintain cleaniness of
  restrooms; Subject to Parks & Recreations Final;Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00384481)

Item #3:  Rachel Shannon on behalf of Wilder’s Prep Academy Charter to host an Annual Field Day
  Event at 700 Warren Lane,Edward Vincent Jr. Park ,Public Property, on Thursday, June 6
  ,2024, from 10:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day event at Edward Vincent Park. Subject
  to Parks / Recreation approval for use of the park; Approved Conditionally; Applicant to hire
  a minimum of ten (10) professional / licensed security guards -OR- school security staff
  members to control the ingress and egress of the parking lots being used for this event;
  Security, faculty-staff, parent volunteers are to wear reflective vests so that they are readily
  identifiable as safety team members; male and female security - staff staff deployed to the
  public restrooms being used by guests for safety of those (specifically children) utilizing the
  restrooms and prevent any potential lewd conduct by outsiders. Applicant to also hire
  Parks & Recreation Staff to maintain cleaniness of restrooms; Subject to Parks &
  Recreations Final approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department;
  and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00384482)
